d:
Hey Ganaraya is a heartfelt tribute to Lord Ganpati, celebrating the deep love and devotion of his followers. Its lyrics and melody express the profound connection between devotees and Bappa, the remover of obstacles. With traditional and contemporary elements, it encapsulates the essence of unwavering faith and spiritual love. It’s time to enjoy the festivities with !
Song credits :
Singers : Neeti Mohan, Suhit Abhyankar
Music: Suhit Abhyankar.
Lyrics: Suhit Abhyankar.
Special Thanks: Azeem Dayani
Mixed Mastered: Eric Pillai ( Future Sound Of Bombay )
